verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both crowd the 'Sunset Sessions' headline against the edge of the circle. Both put the RSVP button in the same grid as the Free Entry, All Ages and Tastings pills, so the CTA reads as just another tag. Both strand 'Reserve a spot' on the right, away from its button, cram the fine print to an unreadable size, and clip the placeholder image at the bottom edge. A's 'Saturday 21 June' is larger and competes with the headline, so B's slightly smaller date keeps a marginally clearer hierarchy.
